newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-CHAT-SHOW HOST KOMPELA DROPPED, FINED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHAT-SHOW HOST KOMPELA DROPPED, FINED.

text.p: Turkish soccer club Canakkale Dardanel have dropped South African Steve Kompela and fined him for hosting a TV chat-show, club spokesman Turan Erginbas said on Thursday.

Kompela, 29, transferred from Turkish club Gaziantep at the beginning of the season, has picked up enough rudimentary Turkish to interview guests and even sing the occasional song on his "Kompela Show".

"We bought him to play football, not to appear on television. He hasn't turned up to training for a week, I guess he's decided to leave football and take a job in TV full-time, so for that reason the club has decided to fine him," Erginbas said.
He did not say how big the fine would be.
Struggling Canakkale Dardanel are currently fourth from bottom in the Turkish first division.
